title: Niagara Falls Tour from Toronto: Boat Ride & Journey Behind Falls
includes: Sightseeing along the Niagara Parkway, Floral Clock, & Power hydro stations
Skip the line - Niagara Falls Boat Cruise (optional)
Free time in Niagara Falls to explore, dine, and enjoy other activities
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Hornblower Boat Cruise not available from January - April 31st. And will be replaced by similar activity. Either Journey or Skylon tower or Niagara Power Station.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take our most competitive and reward winning Niagara Falls day tour with Skip the line option to Niagara City Cruise & Journey Behind the falls ! Travel 125 Ft below and Walk thru limestone Tunnels construed 130 Years Ago. take photos of Falls from the observation Deck located 30 Stories Below the River. Also have the opportunity to enjoy the Niagara falls from below by boarding the Famous Niagara City Cruise ( former Maid of the Mist)

Enjoy complimentary pickups from Downtown Toronto. This tour is well-equipped with licensed tour guides, who are dedicated to make your experience a memorable one. Take a full-day tour with a Journey behind the Falls and Niagara City Cruise option or combine for all!
